blocks.text: Here are summer 2026 updates for the Libertarian Party of New York.
lines: the Libertarian Party of New York.

blocks.text: Registration closed for the 2026-2028 LPNY State Committee elections. The Elections Oversight Committee met to review the registrants. At the present time, local affiliates are voting for their State Committee representatives. Affiliates will have until August 31 to complete their voting. The newly elected State Committee will convene at the 2026 LPNY State Convention to elect the next Executive Committee.

blocks.text: Plans are underway for the 2026 LPNY State Convention, which will be held on October 24, 2026, in Mount Kisco, New York. Additional details, including registration information, will be sent out once registration opens. Members should save the date and watch for future announcements.

blocks.text: For the last several months, the Executive Committee has discussed the necessity of hiring a paid Executive Director. In the meantime, Treasurer Chance Haywood was appointed to the position on June 28, 2026 on a volunteer basis, while the details of the position are being determined for the long term.
